project_meta.title: Pravin Salla - Mechanical Engineering Master's Student Portfolio Concepts

persona_and_concept.core_identity: Ultra-minimalist engineering portfolio platform featuring 4 distinct choosable design concept mockups for Pravin Salla, a Mechanical Engineering Master's student. Each template embodies extreme restraint, generous whitespace, crisp typography, and subtle technical marks without dark neon gradients or heavy blueprint paper clutter.
theme_rules: No heavy gradients or neon dark mode
No repeated drafting paper background from previous version
Maximum 1 primary accent color per concept
Restrained hairline borders and clean alignment rules
High contrast text legibility (WCAG AA / APCA compliant)
Interactive concept switcher to test all 4 templates live

templates.name: 01 / Swiss International Monolith
templates.vibe: Asymmetrical Swiss grid with bold grotesk typography, high-contrast stark white background, sharp 1px grid lines, and an International Klein Blue accent. Inspired by Joseph Müller-Brockmann and industrial graphic design.

type_scale.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-bold tracking-tight leading-none
type_scale.label: text-xs font-mono uppercase tracking-widest text-zinc-500

templates.hero_layout: Asymmetrical 12-column grid. Left 7 columns hold oversized name header, role tag, and concise thesis statement. Right 5 columns host a high-definition framed portrait with subtle coordinate crosshairs and a primary Klein Blue CTA button.
templates.section_headings: CAD-style two-digit index prefix (e.g. '01 // ACADEMIC BACKGROUND') with a full-width 1px hairline border.
templates.card_border_treatment: Sharp 0px rounded corners, 1px solid hairline border (#E4E4E7), hover shift with Klein Blue stroke accent.
signature_micro_details: Alignment crosshair anchors (+) on corner intersections
Strict 1px grid lines separating stats and bio blocks

templates.name: 02 / Editorial Archival Serif
templates.vibe: Quiet academic elegance with expressive serif headlines, spacious asymmetrical margins, warm off-white bone paper background, and a single muted Terracotta/Rust accent. Captures the feel of engineering research monographs and patent archives.

type_scale.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-normal italic tracking-tight leading-tight
type_scale.label: text-xs font-mono uppercase tracking-wider text-stone-500

templates.hero_layout: Centered editorial essay style with massive top whitespace. Roman numeral overline, sweeping italic serif headline, quote-style bio snippet, and a delicate underline link CTA.
templates.section_headings: Roman numerals (e.g. 'III. RESEARCH & EXPERIENCE') paired with italic subtext and warm stone hairline dividers.
templates.card_border_treatment: Soft rounded corners (2px), delicate warm stone border (#E2DDD5), subtle shadow-sm on hover with Terracotta accent details.
signature_micro_details: Side-margin colophon notes with publication dates
Serif initial caps and elegant italic emphasis

templates.name: 03 / Technical Mono System
templates.vibe: Pure engineering precision driven by monospaced typography, precise dimension coordinate labels, light cool gray backdrop, and a single high-visibility Cobalt Blue accent. Feels like an interactive technical datasheet or modern CAD workbench.

type_scale.h1: text-3xl sm:text-4xl lg:text-5xl font-mono font-bold tracking-tighter leading-none
type_scale.label: text-xs font-mono font-semibold tracking-widest text-slate-500 uppercase

templates.hero_layout: Telemetry panel layout. Left column presents structured metadata tags (STATUS: ACTIVE, DEGREE: MS ME, LOCATION: GRAD LAB). Right section features bold monospaced headline, technical specs, and live coordinate indicators.
templates.section_headings: Terminal command format (e.g. '[SYS] --SECTION: PROJECTS_GRID --REV: 2.4') with blue status pill badge.
templates.card_border_treatment: Flat white surface, sharp edges, 1px slate hairline border, blue top-border highlight on hover.
signature_micro_details: Live viewport & component dimension bounding boxes [W: 340px]
Tick-mark ruler ticks along container borders

templates.name: 04 / Soft Neutral Zen Craft
templates.vibe: Serene, spacious, and tactile with vast vertical padding, soft warm stone surfaces, ultra-refined rounded typography, and a quiet Deep Indigo accent. Channels Scandinavian-Japanese functional minimalism.

type_scale.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-light tracking-tight leading-tight
type_scale.label: text-xs font-mono tracking-widest text-neutral-400 uppercase

templates.hero_layout: Quiet asymmetrical split with vertical text badge on the far left, generous empty breathing room, centered quote bio, and soft pill buttons for actions.
templates.section_headings: Subtle dot indicator with clean lowercase title and wide tracking (e.g. '• selected work').
templates.card_border_treatment: Borderless smooth cards on surface color (#F3F2EE), 8px border radius, subtle hover lift without heavy shadows.
signature_micro_details: Vertical text accent badge ('PRAVIN SALLA — 機械工学')
Generous 3x spacing gaps between content sections

instructions_to_main_agent: Implement an interactive Concept Selector bar at the top of the app allowing users to switch dynamically between the 4 Template Concepts ('Swiss Monolith', 'Editorial Archival', 'Technical Mono', 'Soft Zen Craft').
When a template is selected, update the color variables, font styles, micro-annotations, border radiuses, and layout accents across all sections in real-time.
Ensure all 7 required sections are rich with content: Home/Hero, About, Education, Experience Timeline, Projects Grid, Skills Matrix, Contact & Resume Modal.
Maintain strict data-testid attributes on interactive elements for reliable end-to-end testing.
Include a functional Resume Download modal/button action that generates/views Pravin's structured resume.
